plugins.//: prepare: regenerate the build-inlined schemas so VERSION tracks the new release (otherwise src/schemas.generated.ts stays stale and the schema-drift gate fails on the next PR), then lockstep-bump the mcp workspace — one train, one version. publish: build and publish the mcp package after @semantic-release/npm publishes the core.
plugins.prepareCmd: npm run build:schemas && npm version ${nextRelease.version} -w packages/mcp --no-git-tag-version && npm install --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
plugins.publishCmd: npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm publish -w packages/mcp --provenance --access public
